A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same NormGenesis paper and complete Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–39 are identical; page 1 differs only in the arXiv version/date stamp and its link.

before.justification: v1 reports original human and LLM evaluations of refinement, dialogue quality, and downstream generalization in Section 5, plus Malay and Urdu pilot results in Appendix F.2.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original empirical evaluations in Section 5 and pilot results in Appendix F.2.

M1.justification: The four-stage NormGenesis pipeline, exemplar-based iterative refinement, V2R generation, and turn-level annotation procedures are identical in Section 3 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the English, Chinese, and Korean dataset, Malay and Urdu pilots, and DailyDialog, LCCC, and PROSOCIALDIALOG evaluations. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: NormDial, SODA, and untuned GPT-4o-mini retain the same participation in the corresponding comparisons in Tables 7–9. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Sections 4–5 and Appendix E retain identical model configurations, training sample counts, human-evaluation sampling, Likert criteria, and five-turn continuation and preference-testing procedures.

E4.justification: The V2R comparison, cross-linguistic repair-strategy analysis, refinement examples, generation-error analyses, and pilot refinement studies are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Score averaging, Pearson correlation reporting, and Krippendorff's alpha reporting are identical. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including Tables 4–10 and the Malay/Urdu results in Table 22. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Equation (1), the formal annotation definitions in Appendix B, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about exemplar refinement, V2R, the 10,800-dialogue dataset, and improved pragmatic competence and generalization.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and cultural repair interpretations in Section 6 are identical. Limitations concerning language coverage, exemplar scalability, evaluation subjectivity, and evolving norms are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, prompts, annotation instructions, hardware, temperatures, and licensing information are identical. Both retain the same promise to release code, data, and annotation guidelines upon acceptance.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations, and the reference list are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to prior norm-aware dialogue and exemplar-guided generation research.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 22 September 2025 to v2 dated 12 March 2026. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–17, Tables 1–29, Algorithm 1, captions, and page layout are unchanged. The administrative stamp update does not alter their presentation.

improvement.justification: v2 reproduces the same scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendix material. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp and link produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
